questions.question_text: Which move gathers the $x$ terms of $6x + 1 = 4x + 9$ on one side and leaves a positive coefficient of $x$?

options.why: Removes the larger $x$ term, leaving the negative coefficient $-2x$ on the right.
Adds the term instead of subtracting it, so the $x$ terms are not cleared from the right.
Clears a constant rather than an $x$ term, so $x$ still appears on both sides.

questions.solution_text:
$6x + 1 = 4x + 9$
Subtracting $4x$ removes the smaller $x$ term and leaves a positive $2x$.
$2x + 1 = 9$

options.why: Adds $2x$ to both sides instead of subtracting it, giving $8x - 5 = 11$.
Subtracts the $5$ from $11$ instead of adding $5$ to both sides.
